### Important Distinctions & Caveats
*   **Person Names vs. Companies:** Many names in the "To:" and "Cc:" fields are individuals (e.g., Kenneth Lay, Jeff Skilling, Kate Symes). These have been excluded from the company list above as they represent people, not organizations.
*   **"Enpower":** Mentioned in one email ("Sierra Pacific Industries, Inc. is in Enpower"). This likely refers to a software platform or database used by Enron rather than an external company name itself, but it could be a proprietary system name. I have listed Sierra Pacific Industries instead.
*   **"Bewag":** In the headline "Mirant Wants Block Bewag Sale To HEW," Bewag was a major German utility (Berliner Elektrizitäts-Werke AG), now part of Vattenfall. It appears only in this news snippet title [Source: PowerMarketers.com Daily Power Report for 11 April 2001].

I am certain that no other distinct corporate entities are named in these passages beyond those listed above.
